query: SELECT f.id, f.title, f.narrative AS body, f.created_at, f.remediation AS verdict FROM findings f WHERE f.created_at > now() - interval '365 days' ORDER BY f.created_at
_comment: Pentest findings + the remediation decision taken. This is the distilled reasoning that post-training a Cyberorbit model should learn from. Use a READ-ONLY DB role; prefer dsnEnv over inlining creds.
Issues + PRs (titles, descriptions, review threads) — where the decision discussion lives. Merged PR -> success, 'not planned' -> failure, feeding outcome-weighted recall.
Optional: internal playbooks/runbooks exposed as a JSON API. Remove if not applicable.
